refill.why: The Welsh is grammatical, but only two BUILD rows are needed and B01 and B02 cover lle more cleanly; the bare 'dw i ddim yn gwybod lle' also reads clipped without 'mae o'.

The Korean makes it an embedded clause ('where she wants to meet'), but the Welsh is a direct question ('lle mae hi isio cyfarfod?'), so the Korean is ambiguous. The open ~ ending would also not fit a complete question.
